title: Mary Elizabeth Jackson
clean_html:
Mary Elizabeth Jackson

Preserved Primary Document • jacksnme.htm

Mary Elizabeth Jackson was the daughter of Robert B. Jackson and Lydia Ann Wright. She was born in Sussex Co., DE. in 1868 and died there in 1897. She married John M. Davis (1863 - 1936). Their children include : Sara Jane Davis (5/30/1894- 1/10/1970) married James Wilmont Kirby Robert H. Davis married Lillie May Johnson Anna C. Davis (1889-1983) married Walter B. Wright William H. Davis married Doris Elise Mosley
